cover.explanation: The PR claims the fix box, and the one judged surface stands on that claim: the base branch already treats max_output_tokens/max_completion_tokens as part of the OpenAI-compatible contract (documented in docs/api/openai.md as available parameters, mirrored and clamped in src/cpp/server/utils/json_utils.cpp and the routing policy), so exposing a provider-reported completion cap on GET /v1/models completes the existing contract on the cloud-model path rather than adding a capability. The field is new to the /v1/models response, but the base-branch source note outranks the docs and supplies the statement of intent, so no issue or RFC is required.

surfaces.by: Base-branch source already reads and stores these fields, per the facts-pass note '[already present in base-branch source: max_output_tokens, max_completion_tokens]': docs/api/openai.md documents `max_completion_tokens` as an available OpenAI-compat parameter ('An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a completion') and `max_output_tokens` likewise, and the base server already handles them (src/cpp/server/utils/json_utils.cpp: 'OpenAI compatibility: mirror max_completion_tokens to legacy max_tokens'; routing_policy.h: 'The caller's requested output-length ceiling (OpenAI max_tokens / max_completion_tokens), when present. This is a ceiling...'). Surfacing a provider-reported cap on GET /v1/models is making an already-read value work on one more path, which is a fix by the existing contract.

explanation.body: The body does not match the diff: the body ticks 'fixes something' but the diff changes scope, surface area, or experience.
explanation.diff: The diff adds CloudServer::parse_cloud_limits (src/cpp/server/backends/cloud/cloud_server.cpp) so cloud model discovery reads context and completion limits from top-level, top_provider, and per_request_limits fields with int/float/string casting, keeps the discovered max_context_window across cache rebuilds via an early return in populate_model_metadata (src/cpp/server/model_manager.cpp), and serializes new max_output_tokens/max_completion_tokens fields on GET /v1/models (src/cpp/server/server.cpp). The body matches the diff on every checkable claim, including the prior top-level-integer-only parsing behavior, the test file names, and the doc updates; the only changed pre-existing test assertion in test/server_endpoints.py preserves its original existence check while adding assertions for the new fields.
explanation.quality: Checked docs/api/openai.md (GET /v1/models field list) and docs/guide/configuration/cloud.md (How discovery works) at the head SHA; both document the new max_output_tokens/max_completion_tokens fields and the extended cloud limit discovery, and no other doc page enumerates these model fields. For tests, verified the extended test/cpp/test_cloud_discovery_policy.cpp cases are wired via add_cpp_ci_test(CI ON) and that test/server_endpoints.py runs in cpp_server_build_test_release.yml; the new exact-value and rebuild-preservation assertions fail on base code, which never emitted the output caps and wiped max_context_window on cloud rebuild.
